name: hk_hkma_actions_search
description: Search Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) enforcement releases against firms: disciplinary actions and pecuniary penalties on banks for Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance breaches, on stored value facility licensees (e-wallets such as WeChat Pay Hong Kong) under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance, and HKMA joint releases with the SFC naming a bank (reprimands and fines). Each hit gives the release id, date, the firm, the kind of action and a link. Filter by a word in the title or firm name (a bank, 'stored value', 'Anti-Money Laundering') or by year. Rows about individuals are dropped and counted in individuals_dropped. Example: query="bank". Use hk_hkma_action_get for the penalty amounts and release text.

query.description: Word in the release title or firm name (e.g. "Hang Seng", "Anti-Money Laundering", "stored value"). Optional.

year.description: Only releases dated in this year (e.g. 2025). Optional.

name: hk_hkma_action_get
description: Get one Hong Kong Monetary Authority enforcement release against a firm by its id (such as 2025/07/20250722-4 from hk_hkma_actions_search): the release date, the firm or banks concerned, the action taken (reprimand, look-back review, pecuniary penalty), the penalty amounts in HK$, the investigation findings, and links to the Statements of Disciplinary Action. Quoted remarks by named HKMA officials are removed. An unknown id returns found:false; a release about an individual returns found:false with empty_reason not_a_firm_action. Example: id="2025/07/20250722-4".

id.description: Release id such as 2025/07/20250722-4, as returned by hk_hkma_actions_search.
